usage_note: Latvian native name, declined normally: Merzļikins follows the 1st declension (-s), and Elvis follows the 2nd declension (-is), giving gen. Elvja. Sports copy usually uses the surname alone (Merzļikins, Merzļikina vārti) or the initial plus surname (E. Merzļikins). The vocative is rare in running copy; the forms Merzļikin! and Elvi! follow the standard pattern. | Tēzaurs morpho-api applied (agreed)
